visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A chef's hands in black gloves are seen working on a professional flat griddle. They use metal spatulas to flip tender pieces of meat and arrange large, fresh lettuce leaves on slices of bread. The kitchen environment is well-lit, showing metallic surfaces and industrial exhaust hoods. Yellow text overlays appear at the bottom. (2) The scene shifts to the storefront of the restaurant at night. The facade is dark gray or black with a minimalist "Full" logo. Several customers are visible inside the small shop, some standing and some seated. A blowtorch is then shown melting a slice of cheese over kimchi and pork on the griddle. (3) The chef continues to assemble sandwiches. Toasted white bread is smeared with a buttery spread. Huge amounts of vibrant green lettuce are piled on, followed by cooked meats and sauces. The assembled sandwiches are placed into sturdy black cardboard boxes branded with the shop's logo. (4) Close-up macro shots show the interior of a "French Confit Duck Leg" sandwich, revealing layers of shredded meat, melted cheese, and purple cabbage. The camera pans across a tray of golden fried sides including thick-cut chips, onion rings, and chicken wings. A pink sparkling drink is poured into a glass.
